messages:
jordan: Morning — finalizing next week's deploy train. Need to lock owners for Wave A items and confirm smoke owners. Planned window Tue 09:00-11:00 PT. Who's on the roster?

sam: I can take core-api migrations (wave A1). Will be oncall Tues. I'll run smoke: db migrations + healthcheck.

emily: I'll own frontend canary and rollback. ETA to be ready by Mon EOD for smoke playbook.

noah: I'll pick up search-indexer (A2) but need a 30m slot to warm caches. Can we do 09:30 start?

jordan: @noah 09:30 works. @sam please add migration rollback steps to the playbook — include the exact sql revert and feature flags.

sam: done. pasted into playbook:
```
-- rollback
ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN foo;
-- revert feature flag: ff_users_new_signup = off
```

emily: FYI I'll run the frontend smoke script and validate metrics in the dashboard. Ping me if A/B test flags need flipping.

dinesh: I'll be backup for platform infra and watch infra-alerts. +1 on 09:30 stagger.

deploy-bot: scheduled: release-train-2026-03-24 | window 09:00-11:00 PT | participants: sam, emily, noah, dinesh | smoke-owner: sam

noah: quick Q — if the indexer takes longer than 25m, we fallback to reduced traffic and retry at 10:15. OK?

emily: OK. add a canary cutoff: 300 errors or latency > 1200ms for >5m -> rollback.

jordan: Good. final checklist: owners locked: sam(api), noah(search), emily(frontend), dinesh(infra). Playbook links: <https://console.internal/runs/release-train/playbooks/2026-03-24>. If no objections I'll mark the roster locked by EOD.

sam: no objections. :thumbsup:

noah: all good from me.

dinesh: ready.

jordan: locking roster. thanks everyone — I’ll post the deploy calendar invite and handoff notes.
